method.record_filter: Only rows labelled match_confidence=high are compared with the supplied hmlr_* columns.
method.property_type: House/cottage allow D/S/T; flat/apartment allow F; single commercial categories and land allow O. Broad or unsupported categories are unverifiable.
method.tenure: Freehold -> F; leasehold and long leasehold -> L. Other labels are unverifiable.
method.price_context: Positive sale-row guide/asking price vs positive, dated HMLR price on high-labelled rows. Context only: never a flag or valuation. Rent is excluded.
method.missing_values: Missing, nonpositive or malformed price_gbp and size_sqft are unverifiable, never imputed.
method.flag_definition: A distinct listing is flagged if at least one comparable property-type or tenure column differs from its supplied HMLR category.
method.limitation: These are CSV column checks, not full X-ray audits. Supplied joins are not independently verified and may refer to a different unit. HMLR values describe historical sales; differences require review.
